detail.command:
git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && changed_paths="$(git status --short | sed 's/^...//')" && unexpected="$(printf '%s
' "$changed_paths" | grep -Ev '^server/(package\.json|tsconfig\.json|\.env\.example|\.gitignore|README\.md|src/(types|config|store|auth|index)\.ts)$' || true)" && if [ -n "$unexpected" ]; then printf 'Unexpected paths:
%s
' "$unexpected"; exit 1; fi
